subject: MAP: dataset curation, ingestion commitments & restricted-use timeline
messages:
From: Sam Harris <sam.harris@brookline-tech.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval dataset exchange — next steps

Hi Aditya / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Brookline is excited to run a quick evaluation against a focused set of seed queries. Before we proceed we'd like a short mutual action plan so procurement can greenlight the data exchange. Key asks from our side:

- A short MAP with milestones and a hard stop for data usage (we can only accept 90-day evaluation use).
- A simple ingest checklist (format, filename conventions, PII handling).
- Confirmation that Redwood will delete the provided test artifacts after the evaluation window and provide a destruction log.

We can share an initial seed bundle (approx 12k examples) once we agree on terms. Can you propose timelines so we can align legal/procurement?

— Sam
Sam Harris | Head of Data Partnerships, Brookline Tech
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Harris <sam.harris@brookline-tech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: dataset curation, ingestion commitments & restricted-use timeline

Sam — appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a draft MAP and our ingestion checklist to make this fast. High level proposal:

1) MAP milestones (approx timeline)
   - Day 0: Brookline uploads seed bundle to S3 share (we provide one-time link)
   - Day 0–3: Redwood sanity check + ingest into isolated evaluation namespace
   - Day 4–14: Brookline runs evaluation (canary rollout with 10% traffic)
   - Day 15: Joint review call to align on results and next steps
   - Day 30: Optional extended window if both sides agree in writing
   - Day 90: Mandatory artifact deletion and verification report delivered by Redwood

2) Usage constraints
   - Evaluation-only: no production routing, no model fine-tuning on supplied artifacts, no derivative dataset redistribution
   - Retention: artifacts held only in isolated evaluation namespace and destroyed at Day 90 by default

3) Security / handling
   - We will not copy seed artifacts into shared production buckets; access is limited to specific eval nodes
   - We can provide an audit log and a signed destruction statement once artifacts are removed

I've attached: MAP_draft_aditya_v3.pdf (concrete milestones + acceptance criteria) and the ingestion checklist (short CSV/JSON file format rules). If this aligns, we'll prepare a one-time S3 presigned URL and DocuSign for the MAP signature.

Next step: Can you confirm Brookline's required retention window (you mentioned 90 days) and whether compliance needs a SOC2 attestation excerpt?

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MAP: dataset curation, ingestion commitments & restricted-use timeline

Forwarding Brookline's thread. Priyom — can you review the MAP draft and confirm the deletion verification steps? Key items we need to lock down before pushing the share link:

- Exact retention mechanics (what deletion looks like: object purge + k/v cache clear + audit export)
- Proof artifact: will be a signed statement + storage operation logs (we should include object etags and timestamped deletes)
- Minimum legal wording for the usage constraint (no fine-tuning / no redistribution) — keep it terse for DocuSign.

I suggest the following additions to the MAP:
- Add explicit 90-day expiration clause with automated delete on Day 90 and optional extension only if both parties sign an amendment
- Add a short SOW bullet: Redwood will provide up to 2 API keys for Brookline test harnessing during the window

Priyom — looping you for legal/ops language and quick greenlight.

—Laura
Laura Bennett | Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Ravi Kumar <ravi.kumar@brookline-tech.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Harris <sam.harris@brookline-tech.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: dataset curation, ingestion commitments & restricted-use timeline

Thanks — this looks promising. A few clarifying points from procurement/security: 

- The 90-day default is acceptable. Can you confirm we will receive a signed destruction report with object-level evidence (filename + etag + delete timestamp)?
- We need a short clause prohibiting model fine-tuning but allow ephemeral caching during inference (we understand caching for latency is necessary).
- Please confirm retention does not include any long-term snapshots in backup systems (we need an assurance backups will not persist beyond the window).

Attached: security_questionnaire_filled.pdf (we pre-populated a few answers; left the deletion-proof question for you).

If you can confirm those three points, we'll have procurement kick off DocuSign acceptance.

—Ravi
Ravi Kumar | Security Program Manager, Brookline Tech
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Kumar <ravi.kumar@brookline-tech.com>, Sam Harris <sam.harris@brookline-tech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: dataset curation, ingestion commitments & restricted-use timeline

Ravi / Sam — thanks for the quick review. Confirmations below and next steps: 

1) Destruction proof: Redwood will provide a signed deletion report containing object filenames, etags (MD5), and UTC delete timestamps; we'll also include the storage operation logs as an appendix.

2) Fine-tuning prohibition: Added explicit language — Redwood will not use supplied artifacts to fine-tune or train models. Ephemeral KV/prefix caching for serving latency is permitted but not persisted in permanent training stores.

3) Backups: We will ensure no long-term snapshot retention. Any operational backups containing the seed artifacts will be automatically purged within 24 hours of Day 90 deletion; this process is documented in the MAP appendix.

Attachments we will deliver on signature: MAP_draft_aditya_v3.pdf, brookline_eval_seed_v1.zip (upload, one-time link), signed deletion_report_template.pdf.

Immediate next steps:
- I will send the one-time S3 presigned link and the DocuSign envelope by EOD PST 2026-12-30.
- Brookline to upload the seed bundle and confirm upload complete (Day 0).
- Schedule joint kickoff (Day 1) — proposed time: Wed Jan 6, 2027 10:00 AM PT (send calendar invite).

If that works, I'll route the MAP for signature and flag Legal for the short amendment language.

Best,
Aditya Rao | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_draft_aditya_v3.pdf (pdf), brookline_eval_seed_v1.zip (zip), signed_deletion_report_template.pdf (pdf)
